sources.title: MLECOG: Motivated Learning Embodied Cognitive Architecture
sources.institution: Ohio University; University of Information Technology and Management, Rzeszow
sources.access: Public institutional indexed text, selected pp.1272,1275,1280–1282; PDF images 502; IEEE copyright

sources.title: Development of Functional Requirements for Cognitive Motivated Machines
sources.access: Repository abstract; full dissertation not reviewed

implemented: Simplified reactive simulated agent; author-reported learning of useful actions and managing resource needs in NeoAxis.
learned: Action outcomes and secondary resource-directed needs derived from supplied primary needs.
designed: Primitive needs, resource/action semantics, goal-generation rule, environmental dynamics, symbolic input and simplified memory.
limit: No grounded symbols or full deliberative planner; section V reports insufficient learning under scarcity and low incentive with abundant food; parameter sensitivity, no organismal reproduction or autonomous origin of primary drives established.
ora: Direct prior art for resource-dependent learning and derived objectives; separate inherited primary drives, derived subgoals and full resource-accounted reproductive viability.

sources.authors: James B. Maxwell; Arne Eigenfeldt; Philippe Pasquier; Nicolas Gonzalez Thomas
sources.title: MusiCOG: A Cognitive Architecture for Music Learning and Generation
sources.access: Public CC BY 3.0 conference paper; pp.521,527,528 visually verified

implemented: Working music continuation system in ManuScore; preliminary learned musical chunks and reuse of generated material.
learned: Hierarchical segment patterns from training music; reuse of earlier learned motifs.
designed: Musical representations, segmentation mechanisms, generation task, supplied seed and corpus.
limit: Domain-specific; key/scale induction and user-feedback learning future work; node-to-input ratio is not measured storage or energy savings.
ora: Useful comparator for reuse of self-generated patterns and separating representation compactness from paid storage.

sources.title: Novamente: An Integrative Architecture for General Intelligence
sources.access: Indexed proceedings text; first-page image 502; no redistribution

sources.title: Experiential Interactive Learning with Novamente: Further Plans and Comments

implemented: Author-described probabilistic inference, optimization and knowledge-mining applications.
learned: Reported pattern and program learning components; experiential interaction not yet performed as of dated August note.
designed: Inference representation, optimizer, goal system and intended educational scaffolding.
limit: Author describes approximately half of design implemented in August 2004; expected self-modification and general intelligence not established by design or application examples. Later versions require separate review.
ora: Separate implemented components, proposed emergent dynamics and actual developmental outcomes; broad self-modification proposal is prior art, not proof of success.

sources.title: Interdisciplinary Foundations for Multiple-task Human Performance Modeling in OMAR
sources.access: Public repository proceedings PDF p.303 visually verified; author copyright

sources.title: Omar Human Performance Modeling in a Decision Support Experiment
sources.access: Publisher abstract only; full article not reviewed

implemented: Human-operator multitask simulations with distributed functional centers and no central executive; use in air-traffic-control simulation reported.
learned: No independently acquired procedure verified in inspected reports.
designed: Functional capabilities, task procedures and coordination mechanisms supplied by modelers.
limit: Model of human performance, not demonstration of spontaneous cognition or validated unique explanation of human multitasking.
ora: Decentralized control can be authored; distributed execution is not evidence of evolved coordination.

sources.title: OSCAR: An Agent Architecture Based on Defeasible Reasoning
sources.access: Public proceedings text, first page visually verified; AAAI copyright

sources.title: A Theory of Defeasible Reasoning
sources.access: Publisher abstract; full text reported unavailable

implemented: Author-reported Lisp inference architecture; supports retractable beliefs, prioritization and reasoning under incomplete knowledge.
learned: Inference-derived beliefs can change with evidence; autonomous acquisition of new inference machinery not demonstrated in inspected sources.
designed: Inference schemes, logical representation, prioritized task queue and planning framework.
limit: Architecture implementation claim does not establish human-level intelligence; no matched performance evaluation or paid reproductive cost in this batch.
ora: Separate revising beliefs under authored rules from evolving the rules themselves; track provenance of conclusions.
